marks.gloss_en: Rav: one who checks for chametz must also nullify it
crumbs are insignificant and self-nullified; being guarded with the house does not confer significance either -- significance follows the owner's caring (the fig-gleanings baraita)
Rava: a decree, lest he find a fine loaf after the search and his mind be upon it -- owned, significant chametz the bedika never covered
he may find it only after the prohibition sets in, when it is no longer in his possession to nullify
bittul is not prescribed for the fourth or fifth hour: neither prohibition-time nor biur-time, so he may neglect it
